name: 5-MeO-AET
summary: 5-MeO-αET, also known as 5-methoxy-α-ethyltryptamine, is a psychoactive drug of the tryptamine and α-alkyltryptamine families. It reportedly produces psychedelic and stimulant effects.

pharmacology.text: The pharmacology of 5-MeO-αET has been studied. It is a weak partial agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, with a binding affinity (Ki) of 4,073 nM, an EC50 of 166 nM, and an Emax of 34%. For comparison, αET showed 14-fold lower affinity for the receptor than 5-MeO-αET and was inactive as an agonist of the receptor. The individual stereoisomers of 5-MeO-αET and αET were also assessed.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen
